sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: []{#sec:intro label="sec:intro"} The space of three-dimensional superconformal field theories is vast and only partially explored. sections.title: Non-abelian line defects
sections.extract: There are natural ways to use the three-dimensional theories $T_M$ to define domain walls in the UV for four-dimensional ${\cal N}=2$ $SU(2)$ gauge theories. A full account of that construction will be the subject of a future publication [@DGGV-hybrid]. For now, we will content ourselves with sketching some interesting directions of inquiry. For simplicity, we will focus on the example of $SU(2)$ ${\cal N}=2^*$ SYM.
